Question: As Salaam Alaikum I had seen a dream some 10 years back.At that time my parents had gone for hajj.I was suffering from maleria with high fever and body pain.My brother, sister and uncle were at home.After dinner we all went to sleep, I was having very high pain in my body & i was not able to sleep. I was lying on the bed and suddenly i saw two men dressed in all white coming towards me, they greeted me and started talking to me and inquired about my health. i told them about my fever and body pain.They sat close to my legs started massaging my legs, i was feeling very comfortable and they pain just vanished. all the time they were talking to me but i dont remember what exactly they were talking but they made me feel very comfortable.i forgot every thing about the pain and was talking and laughing with them. Then all of a sudden I heard a sound calling my name,it was my uncle who was waking me up.When i opened my eyes The 2 person were not there. I asked my uncle about the 2 person & he told me that i must have seen a dream but i could not believe it because it was so real. But i could not recollect the faces of the 2 persons. Please tell me the tabeer of this dream. Answer ID: 5512 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 884/664=H) It is not Islamically and rationally impossible for the righteous men (buzurgs) to appear in dreams and remove pains of dreamers whether the righteous man is known and acquainted or not. The same case is with your dream. Ma-sha-Allah, your dream is noble and blessed one. Meaning of the dream is: you gain benefit from the righteous men. But in future, if you do every thing as per Shariah commandments and abide by the Sunnah, the advantages seen in dreams will be established and lasting, otherwise they will get short-lived and will vanish soon. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
